# SEMVER EXCEPTIONS - the budlum-core public API breakage exception list (step 1, 2026-07-21)
#
# This list must stay EMPTY; an empty list = the cargo-semver-checks gate runs
# fully fail-closed (item 5: public API breakage detection -> FAIL).
#
# Exception rules (the same discipline as deny.toml [advisories]):
#   * Each line carries a single accepted breakage and MUST contain a justification.
#   * No line is added without approval; the approval evidence (a STATUS_ONLINE
#     entry / decision note) is referenced on the line.
#   * Format: <semver-checks lint name or API surface> | <justification> | <approval evidence>
#
# Example (a template - NOT ACTIVE, kept commented out with #):
#   # method_missing: AccountState::legacy_probe | deliberate pre-mainnet API
#   #   cleanup, the 0.x version line | STATUS_ONLINE 2026-07-21 approval
#
# Note: comment lines in this file DO NOT AFFECT the gate; only non-comment
# lines count as exceptions (see scripts/check-semver.sh).
#
# EIP-1559 fee distribution (step G): a new public method.
# AccountState::distribute_block_fees - fee distribution at block finalization.
# cargo-semver-checks detects that a new method was added; on this 0.x version
# line a minor addition is accepted. Approval: STATUS_ONLINE 2026-07-21.
AccountState::distribute_block_fees | EIP-1559 fee distribution wiring (step G) - a new public method wired into block finalization | STATUS_ONLINE 2026-07-21 approval

# PR12 intentional breakages (P01-P06 waves): every entry is a finding fix
# that changes a public API before mainnet, approved by the corresponding
# BLG decision recorded on PR #9's decision comment (karar). The 0.x line
# accepts these as deliberate pre-mainnet cleanup; none is accidental.
BridgeState::lock | bridge lock takes the full 9-argument envelope (recipient_eth, unwind paths) - BLG-0037/0041 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0037=A+B, BLG-0041=A)
BridgeState::mint | mint takes the message reference plus the current height for expiry sweeps - BLG-0083 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0083=B+A+C)
bridge_burn_payload_hash | burn payload hash binds (asset, amount, eth recipient) - BLG-0087 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0087=A+B)
BridgeRelayerPipeline::from_parts | pipeline stages are explicit and enqueue_stage-carrying - BLG-0083 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0083=A+C)
verify_evm_receipt | verification takes the operator trusted checkpoint for the BLG-0111 finality rule - BLG-0111/0115 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0111=B A-interim, BLG-0115=B)
EthereumSyncAdapter::new | constructor takes the pinned committee (period, aggregate key, next root) - BLG-0130/0131 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0130/0131=B)
FinalityAttestation | attestation binds attested block hash and event/tx roots - BLG-0132/0133 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0132/0133=NO ROWS, coded per finding text)
ZkVmFinalityAdapter::new | constructor pins program hash and chain id; unpinned admission is closed - BLG-0134 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0134=A now)
AdapterSpec::ZkVm | the registry spec carries the program hash and chain id pins - BLG-0134 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0134=A now)
rotate_period | rotation returns Result and refuses without the finality branch - BLG-0137 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0137=A later/B interim)
SyncCommitteeError | new RotationBranchRequired variant for the refused rotation - BLG-0137 kararı | PR #9 decision comment (BLG-0137=B interim)
